Six net-new pr-marketing leads, all Grade A/B, led by Oak ($60M identity-security seed, out of stealth today = perfect launch trigger) and two pure-fintech infrastructure plays (Cyclops stablecoin payments, Glacis Labs digital-asset clearing).
